meta.coverage_note: 339 real street-level photos within the block bbox + 50 m (KartaView 58, Mapillary 281). Photos are shown as published (platform-blurred), never synthesised; x/y are local metres from meta.origin (Web-Mercator/k convention, y north); heading_deg is the camera compass bearing (null = not recorded).
meta.privacy: No person-identifying processing; whole frames downscaled only; KartaView frames without platform blur status BLURRED are metadata-only.
meta.artifact_csp_note: Artifact pages block external URLs, so only local thumbs render inside the artifact; 'url' links open the platform page.
